_comment: Every Arauna character that reuses an Emerald trainer/overworld slot.
The internal IDs never change: ADEMAR is TRAINER_PIC_LEADER_BRAWLY and
OBJ_EVENT_GFX_BRAWLY for ever, and only the art the player sees differs.
surfaces says which halves are integrated. 'front' means the battle
portrait is in; 'overworld' means the walking sheet and its palette are.
A surface listed here is validated strictly; one that is absent is
reported as outstanding rather than silently passing.

characters.name: ELIAS
characters.palette_slot_reason: He shares the LittlerootTown houses with two Vigoroth and the rival, which hold the special slot, but never at the same moment: FLAG_HIDE_PLAYERS_HOUSE_DAD is cleared only in hall_of_fame.inc, by which time the Vigoroth are hidden for good. Runtime confirms the special slot carries his palette.

same_slot_safe_with.CIRO F1: Audited: never on screen together. ELIAS is hidden behind FLAG_HIDE_PLAYERS_HOUSE_DAD, which nothing clears until hall_of_fame.inc, and the rival's ground-floor object is hidden at new game and never shown again.
same_slot_safe_with.CIRO F1 MIRROR: Audited: never on screen together. ELIAS is hidden behind FLAG_HIDE_PLAYERS_HOUSE_DAD, which nothing clears until hall_of_fame.inc, and the rival's ground-floor object is hidden at new game and never shown again.

characters.name: CAETANO
characters.palette_slot_reason: He stands beside CECILIA in MossdeepCity_Gym at x=24,y=7 with no hide flag, so the two are always on screen together and cannot share one palette bank. Runtime confirms bank 11 carries his palette while CECILIA holds bank 10.

characters.name: AMALIA
characters.palette_slot_reason: The Rayquaza scene in SootopolisCity adds the redrawn Rayquaza, which holds PALSLOT_NPC_SPECIAL, while she stands at 31,33 and is never removed, so she takes the second special bank.

characters.name: CIRO F1 MIRROR
characters.palette_slot_reason: The engine picks the rival graphic opposite the player's gender, so CIRO occupies both rival slots with one design and one palette. Only one of the two is ever spawned, so the shared tag never contends.

characters.name: CIRO F3
characters.palette_slot_reason: Alone on the special bank in EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom; AMALIA holds the reflection bank there.

surfaces_not_applicable.front: No battle exists in this phase. The EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom object carries script 0x0 and TRAINER_TYPE_NONE, so a portrait would occupy a trainer pic slot nothing can ever display.

characters.name: VAL
characters.palette_slot_reason: PetalburgCity_Gym_OnTransition parks ELIAS at 4,107 while VAL stands at 4,111 in the same entrance room, so the two are on screen together and ELIAS holds the first special bank.

surfaces_not_applicable.front: The Victory Road objects are cutscene appearances with TRAINER_TYPE_NONE; VAL's battles all run from OBJ_EVENT_GFX_WALLY and use the portrait installed there.

characters.name: BRENO
characters.palette_slot_reason: Allocated from the pool, which is what unblocks him: the submarine shadow in AquaHideout_B2F holds both special banks, and runtime confirms he takes bank 14 while it keeps 10 and 11.

characters.name: OTACILIO
characters.palette_slot_reason: Allocated from the general sprite palette pool. In SootopolisCity's five-way scene the pool is full and he takes an idle reflection bank instead -- measured per owner, not per map: nothing in that scene is on NPC_2, NPC_3 or NPC_4, so their reflection banks are never read. The fallback in his graphics info is PALSLOT_NPC_1 and is not reached there.

characters.name: RAUL
characters.palette_slot_reason: Allocated from the pool like the rest of the story cast. His fallback is PALSLOT_NPC_1, measured empty on all three of his maps; PALSLOT_NPC_2 is where the Magma grunts stand and falling back onto their bank would put him in their colours again.
characters.graphics_id_reason: He has no static graphics id: every unused doll is already another Arauna character's and NUM_OBJ_EVENT_GFX cannot grow. He is reached instead through the Arauna virtual graphics registry, with OBJ_EVENT_GFX_VAR_B in the map data and ARAUNA_VIRTUAL_GFX_RAUL in VAR_OBJ_GFX_ID_B, set by the ON_TRANSITION script of each of his three maps.

characters.name: MAIRA
characters.palette_slot_reason: Battle Tower. The room's two attendants are on NPC_1, so NPC_4 -- the slot her graphics info already named -- stays the documented fallback.
characters.runtime_notes: One Circuit Master per facility, never two at once: the overworld is written into VAR_OBJ_GFX_ID_0 by SetFrontierBrainObjEventGfx, and only TADEU also stands as a fixed object, at the Pyramid summit. Silver and Gold share this front, this overworld and this name -- GetFrontierBrainTrainerPicIndex, GetFrontierBrainTrainerClass and CopyFrontierBrainTrainerName all read sFrontierBrainTrainerIds[facility] with no symbol input, so only the party and the result text differ.

characters.palette_slot_reason: Falls back to PALSLOT_NPC_4, the bank this slot used before. Sixty-one map objects wear this graphic and they all share the single bank its tag holds, so the pool cost is one, not sixty-one.
characters.runtime_notes: An archetype, not a person: the same graphic and palette serve every grunt of that faction and gender, so the cost is one palette bank per variant on screen. The internal names stay Aqua and Magma; the player sees HORIZONTE and LEMBRANTE, which the trainer class names and the trainer names AGENTE and ATIVISTA already say.

protagonist_states.note: Both sheets of this state share one 16-colour bank, and the approved conversion quantised walking and running separately: 29 distinct colours across the pair, against a hardware ceiling of 16. No shared palette can represent both without changing pixels, so the state is not integrable until PixelLab re-exports the pair against one palette.
protagonist_states.blocked_by: walking and running do not share a palette

_protagonist_comment: Player avatar states. Unlike the characters above, a player state is not
one 144x32 sheet: each has its own frame size, pic table and animation
table, and NORMAL alone spans two sheets sharing a single palette.
status is asset readiness, never a claim about the tree: READY means the
Arauna art is installed and wired, PARTIAL means art exists but cannot be
used as delivered, MISSING means no approved art exists. Anything not
READY must still be wired to the inherited Emerald art -- a state half in
Arauna and half in Brendan/May is the one outcome worse than waiting.
